Screen checkConfirm in Vanderbilt's Oracle or UKG during a recorded demo: How Vanderbilt provides NY PFL, NY and CA sick leave, and DC PFL, and who administers each; How state sick leave plans are configured in Oracle Absence Management and UKG; Current NY PFL contribution rate and DC PFL tax rate; Whether State Leave is the right Document Records type for state leave paperwork (confirm with Sheila, Leave SME).

1 · Intro

When to use it.

Some states and cities require leave and benefits beyond federal law, such as paid sick leave and paid family leave. They apply based on where the person works.

You don't administer these programs, but you should know they exist, keep the location right, and route questions early.

Use this whenYou are hiring or supporting an employee who works in New York, California, DC, or another state with its own leave laws.

2 · Walk through

Examples to know.

Check off each item as you read.

Examples by location
LocationProgram
New YorkPaid Family Leave; paid sick leave (NYC has its own)
CaliforniaPaid sick leave (at least 5 days or 40 hours)
DCPaid Family Leave (employer-funded)

Watch-outs

  • Rates, caps, and amounts change often. Use the official state site, not an old summary.
  • Open item: confirm with your engagement consultant (EC) how Vanderbilt provides and tracks state leave and benefits for out-of-state employees, and who administers each.
  • Open item: confirm with your EC how state sick leave is set up in Oracle Absence Management and UKG for monthly and biweekly employees.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • NY Paid Family Leave: Employer Responsibilities and Resources (opens in a new tab)
  • California DIR: Paid Sick Leave FAQ (opens in a new tab)

3 · Knowledge check

Check your understanding.

Three questions. You get feedback on each answer. All three right completes the course.

Q1What decides which state's leave laws apply to an employee?

Q2Under California's paid sick leave law, how much leave must an employer allow an employee to use each year, at minimum?

Q3An employee in New York City asks about sick leave. What should you remember?

4 · Job aid

Keep it handy.

A one-page version of the steps and watch-outs. Print it or save it as a PDF.
